# Record 12 is junk, and attempt 2 is documentation

Record 12 is a contrived command I ran out of habit while setting up attempt 2. It proves nothing, it
is cited by nothing, and it stays where it is. This is the second time in this repository: record 8 of
SEEN-088 is the other. Both are disowned rather than removed, because a journal that can be tidied is
not a journal, and two of them in eleven tickets is worth knowing about.

Attempt 2 changes documentation only. The reconciliation renumbered the revision's two tickets to
SEEN-096 and SEEN-097, restored three sentences and the command list to CLAUDE.md, and put back eight
statuses the revision had reset. No code changed: the check this ticket adds was written, tested and
green in attempt 1, at records 4 and 5, and the regression at record 13 covers everything again.

So the tdd record takes the non-code path, with change_type policy: the harness's own conventions and
the backlog's numbering are what moved.

The reconciliation is also this ticket's best evidence. SEEN-095 was opened because two statuses went
stale unnoticed; its check then found eight more that a plan revision had reset, each named with the
receipt commit proving it merged. It has now caught ten in an afternoon.
